A second log, zhangming.log, was recovered from the same storage volume but is explicitly not an account on this device; the README identifies it as originating from a previous owner or shared partition. Timeline proximity exists (both logs timestamped 2024-04-10 21:02–21:47), but the evidence does not support interaction, causation, or shared intent between the device user and zhangming. The content of zhangming.log (cryptocurrency deposits, platform registrations, group maintenance) is unrelated to wangfang's activities, and no execution, logon, or communication artifacts link the two parties beyond co-residency on the same volume.
